overview: Majapahit was the last major Hindu-Buddhist empire in Indonesia, claiming suzerainty over much of the archipelago. Known for the epic Nagarakretagama poem, intricate brick temple architecture and a powerful navy that controlled the spice trade.

items.text: The Nagarakretagama poem composed, describing the empire's vast extent and court rituals.
Terracotta sculpture and brick temple architecture in a distinctive East Javanese style.
Wayang shadow puppetry and gamelan music developed as major art forms.
Controlled the spice trade in cloves, nutmeg and mace from the Moluccas.
Diplomatic and trade relations with China, India, Champa and Siam.
Hinduism and Buddhism coexisted with indigenous Javanese beliefs in a syncretic system.
The mandala concept of political organization with a divine king at the center.
Majapahit's territorial claims influenced modern Indonesian national identity.
Hindu-Buddhist traditions survived in Bali, which Majapahit nobles fled to after the fall.

fall.text: The rising Islamic Demak Sultanate conquered Majapahit's capital, ending the empire.
